task: closed-set single-label topical classification over legal/finance/science/technology
answer_form: single letter; the letter->domain mapping is the closed-set response contract (identical for every sample), NOT sample gold

labels.definition: text whose primary subject is law/legal instruments: statutes, regulations, case law, rulings, legal obligations.
text whose primary subject is finance/markets/companies/business: earnings, trading, investment, corporate financial activity.
text whose primary subject is natural/biological/physical/mathematical science or medical research.
text whose primary subject is computing/software/hardware/engineering technology (excluding finance and natural science).

boundary_rules: machine-learning papers that are applied to finance are ambiguous; assign by primary subject: methods/CS = technology, markets/companies = finance.
bioinformatics / quantitative biology = science unless the primary artifact is a computing system.
crypto/quant trading text = finance when the subject is markets, technology when the subject is the algorithm/system.
statistical-method papers posted in both cs.*/stat = science (math/stat) when theory-led, technology when the contribution is a software/CS system.
ambiguity_policy: gold is the single best-fit domain; ties broken by primary subject noun, recorded as a teacher-disagreement slice, not by editing the ontology after seeing errors.
frozen_note: Ontology is frozen before any teacher inference. Boundary rules may only be clarified, not repurposed, via a corrective checkpoint.
